groups.definition: Risk that AI use produces flawed outputs, becomes obsolete, increases cybersecurity exposure, or incurs costs under an evolving AI legal landscape.
Risk that unsettled law on AI ownership and copyright leads to loss of IP rights or infringement claims from AI use in products and operations.
Risk that evolving autonomous vehicle regulation and accident or cyber liability impede commercialization, raise costs, and deter adoption.
Risk that trade secrets and intellectual property are stolen through IT intrusions, heightened by AI adoption.
